children: Zilliqa will activate its second hard fork on September 22nd, enabling the escrow contract required for the ZKP migration tool. The tool audit is complete and internal testing is underway; exchanges will set their own schedules for restoring Zilliqa EVM deposits and withdrawals.
The ZKP migration tool audit is complete, and internal testing is underway.
Rollout is targeted for 22 September, when the second hard fork activates the required escrow contract.

Zilliqa (ZIL) is a public, permissionless blockchain designed to offer high throughput and secure smart contract execution. Launched in 2017, it was the first blockchain to implement sharding, a technology that allows new blocks to be confirmed in parallel, which significantly increases the number of transactions the network can handle per second. The native cryptocurrency of Zilliqa, also called ZIL, is used for transaction fees and as the 'gas' for executing smart contracts. The project's main aim is to enable new solutions to the scalability problem of existing blockchains, thereby allowing for blockchain technology to be effectively utilized in sectors demanding high-speed transactions, such as digital advertising, gaming, and financial services.

title: Zilliqa to Undergo Hard Fork on September 22nd
